description: BOLD5000 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：bold5000 质控汇总；bold5000 表型/刺激提取；bold5000 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: bold5000 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries for BOLD5000。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: bold5000 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and organize BOLD5000 stimulus metadata for downstream analysis。 Inputs: stimulus_dir: Path to BOLD5000 stimuli directory (directory); events_dir: Path to BOLD5000 events directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: bold5000 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Verify and reorganize BOLD5000 data into BIDS-style layout. BOLD5000 from OpenNeuro is already in BIDS format; this script validates and optionally copies/reorganizes the structure。 Inputs: input: Path to BOLD5000 data directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/.

name: bold5000-skill
